5a9ce647a34b32dddf096dd7f17697b44a5f5b0b.summary: Google Threat Intelligence Group's January 2025 report on how government-backed and information-operations actors used Google's Gemini AI assistant. Actors mostly used it for research, coding, reconnaissance, translation and content creation. The report finds no novel AI capabilities and says jailbreak attempts failed. Iranian actors were the heaviest APT users, with APT42 focused on phishing. Chinese actors sought target reconnaissance and post-compromise access. North Korean actors used it alongside a clandestine IT worker scheme. Russian APT use was limited. Financially motivated actors…
